title: Automation triggers
description: What an automation's definition must say and when it comes due: a trigger daily or weekly at a time, or a watched query and the edge it fires on (first, each, first_per, crosses), and what a watched query's edge meets from one pass to the next, remembered under due_on:<automation>. On a map without the automations pack it does nothing. The automations pack does what one says once it is due.
